summary: Inactive dried yeast made from 100% Saccharomyces cerevisiae cells grown on sugar cane molasses. Used in aqua, poultry, swine, cattle and pet feed.
metaDescription: Nutriments-MDY inactive dried yeast made from Saccharomyces cerevisiae grown on molasses. 40% minimum crude protein. Dosage for aqua, poultry and cattle.
description: Nutriments-MDY is a natural fermentation product made of 100% Saccharomyces cerevisiae cells, grown on sugar cane molasses. Inactive yeast is a good protein source with a balanced amino acid profile and useful levels of lysine, methionine and threonine. It is also a natural source of B vitamins.

It acts as a prophylactic micro-ingredient and immune system booster. It also adds natural palatability to the feed, which improves feed intake and feed conversion. Appearance: light brown, thin powder.

description: Nutrimins-DMM is a minerals mix for livestock nutrition, supplied as a cattle feed supplement. The Nutrimins-DMM name and logo are registered under Trade Mark No. 4064646 in Class 31.

A sample was analysed at the Animal Feed Analytical and Quality Assurance Laboratory, TANUVAS, Namakkal, in January 2019. Aflatoxins B1, B2, G1 and G2, ochratoxin, T-2 toxin, citrinin and zearalenone were not detected. The lab's test results relate only to the sample that was tested. The report is on our quality page.

summary: Chocolate-flavoured oral gel for dairy cattle and buffaloes, with calcium, phosphorus, magnesium, vitamin D3 and an energy base of dextrose and propylene glycol. 300 g bottle.
metaDescription: Sun Calci Gold, a 300 g oral calcium, phosphorus and magnesium gel with vitamin D3 for dairy cattle and buffaloes. Composition and directions for use.
description: Sun Calci Gold is meant for the transition period: before calving, after calving, during stress conditions such as transport, heat and illness, and for high yielding animals. It is chocolate flavoured.
benefits: Prevents milk fever: helps maintain normal calcium levels in blood
Supports milk production: improves milk yield and quality
Faster recovery: helps the animal recover quickly after calving
Better uterine health: supports normal uterine contraction and expulsion of placenta
Energy booster: provides instant energy with dextrose and propylene glycol
Improves fertility: helps improve conception rate and reproductive health

dosage.v: 1 bottle (300 g), 12 to 24 hours before expected calving
1 bottle (300 g) immediately after calving. Repeat after 12 hours if required.
Use as per the advice of a veterinarian or animal nutritionist
